findings.issue: Floor-1 /render endpoint had no PDP gate. actor was extracted then voided. renderFloor1 did not receive actor or authzDeps and did not call checkReadGrant. RESOLVED in a8dd79b: renderFloor1 now receives actor, nowMs, authzDeps and calls authzDeps.checkReadGrant before withTenantTx, mirroring dataFloor2.

defaultCheckReadGrant used the wrong grant pool: loadAdminContext only loads mgmt_object:* grants; operation=read does not exist on mgmt_object:*, so all non-genesis users were denied. RESOLVED in a8dd79b: defaultCheckReadGrant rewritten with direct JOIN grant x role_assignment filtering resource_type=application, operation=read, confirmed_by IS NOT NULL, validity windows on both grant and role_assignment.

AC-6 NO_READ_GRANT had no live DB probe. RESOLVED in a8dd79b: new file ci/checks/db/report_page_render_ac6.test.ts adds 4 live probes (AC-6-DENY-FLOOR1, AC-6-DENY-FLOOR2, AC-6-ALLOW-FLOOR1, AC-6-ALLOW-FLOOR2), all passing.
FIELD_KEY_SAFE_RE includes hyphen `-` in charset. No security concern; hyphen is valid in jsonb keys. Undocumented intentional inclusion.

findings.issue: AC-6 unit test passes empty FakePool with denyDeps. Safe because denyDeps fires before pool touch, but fragile if logic order changes.

findings.issue: Scope-containment hole: defaultCheckReadGrant checks for ANY application/read grant in the tenant without matching grant.scope against the specific app_id of the requested page. A grant scoped to App-A gives access to all pages in the tenant (App-B, App-C, etc.). ADR T-0121 §6 states 'Гранулярность просмотра — на уровне application' (per-app granularity). The full PDP T-0021 resolveFor path enforces this correctly via isNarrowerOrEqual(refToScope(page.app_id), grant.scope, ancestry). The current checkReadGrant interface does not accept app_id. This is day-1 acceptable: multi-app tenants with per-app grant scoping are not a day-1 deployment pattern, and ADR §6 defers to T-0021 for full PDP. Needs resolution when T-0021 is wired into the render path.
findings.suggestion: When integrating T-0021 into render-path: replace checkReadGrant with resolveFor(deps, {tenantId, ref:{kind:'application', applicationId: page.app_id}}, subject, 'read'). Alternatively extend checkReadGrant signature to (pool, tenantId, actor, nowMs, appId) and add scope-containment check in the JOIN.

role_gap_evidence: R-6 reveals that defaultCheckReadGrant is a tenant-wide application/read gate, not a per-app gate. Full per-app scope-containment requires T-0021 resolveFor integration into the render path. This is a tracked tech-debt item, not a blocking gap for T-0181.
